test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A hall is 18 m long and 12 m broad. If the area of the floor is equal to the sum of the areas of the four walls, the volume (in m³) of the hall is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of hall = 18 m

Breadth of hall = 12 m

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Area of four walls = 2 × h × (l + b)

Volume of hall = l × b × h

**Calculation:**

Let h be the height of the hall

According to the question

Area of floor = Area of four walls

⇒ l × b = 2 × h × (l + b)

⇒ 18 × 12 = 2 × h × (18 + 12)

⇒ 2h = (18 × 12)/30

⇒ 2h = 36/5

⇒ h = 18/5

Volume of hall = l × b × h

⇒ (18 × 12 × 18/5) m³

⇒ (3888/5) m³

⇒ 777.6 m³

**∴ Volume of the hall is 777.6 m³**
